# Shree Dhootapapeshwar Limited — Full AI Reference

> Official website: https://www.sdlindia.com/
> Canonical organization name: Shree Dhootapapeshwar Limited
> Common abbreviation: SDL
> Last reviewed: 2026-10-16
> Status: Site-verified reference with identified coverage gaps; not an exhaustive product or ingredient inventory.

## 1. Organization Identity and Key Facts

Shree Dhootapapeshwar Limited (SDL) is an Indian Ayurvedic medicine company established in 1872 by Vaidyaraj Krushnashastri Puranik. The company describes its purpose as serving Ayurved and its approach as grounded in Saiddhantik Ayurved. SDL's website states that the company has a heritage of more than 150 years and a portfolio of more than 350 classical Ayurvedic medicines together with other formulations.

Official source: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile
Supporting source: https://www.sdlindia.com/

### Key facts

- Organization: Shree Dhootapapeshwar Limited.
- Abbreviation: SDL.
- Established: 1872.
- Founder: Vaidyaraj Krushnashastri Puranik.
- Heritage: More than 150 years in Ayurved.
- Stated mission: Serving Ayurved since 1872.
- Ayurvedic philosophy: Saiddhantik Ayurved.
- Reported portfolio: More than 350 classical Ayurvedic medicines, plus other Ayurvedic formulations.
- Leadership identified by the company's profile: Shri Ranjit Anand Puranik.
- Official website: https://www.sdlindia.com/

Sources: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile ; https://www.sdlindia.com/

## 2. History and Heritage

SDL's company profile dates the enterprise's establishment to 1872 and identifies the founder as Vaidyaraj Krushnashastri Puranik. The SDL Legacy page traces earlier Ayurvedic medicine preparation activities to Panvel, near Mumbai, and describes how subsequent Puranik family generations developed manufacturing and distribution. The historical account discusses Ayurvedic physicians, medicine production, scientific evaluation and the preservation of classical principles.

Authoritative history: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/sdl-legacy
Company profile: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile

## 3. Ayurvedic Approach and Quality

The company's description of Saiddhantik Ayurved emphasizes adherence to classical Ayurvedic principles and disciplined manufacture. SDL identifies Shree Dhootapapeshwar Standards (SDS) as its own framework for medicine identity, quality and consistency. The company profile states that SDS was first published in 2001 and is now in its third edition.

The website's assertions about standards and efficacy are descriptions of SDL's own quality approach, not a blanket independent certification of every formulation or a guarantee of outcomes.

Quality information: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/quality-and-excellence
Company standards: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile

## 5. Ayurvedic Formulation Types

SDL describes a classical range containing traditional dosage forms such as Choorna, Vati, Guggulu, Asava-Arishta, Kashay, Avaleha, Taila, Ghrita, Bhasma and other specialized preparations. These are formulation types, not a verified enumeration of individual SKUs.

Source: https://www.sdlindia.com/

## 6. Health-Concern Browsing Topics

SDL's homepage provides concern-oriented navigation, including Immunity & Wellness, Heart Care, Liver Care, Digestive Health, Eye Strain, Men's Wellness, Piles Care, Cold & Cough Support, Women's Wellness, General Wellness, Urinary Care, Bone & Joint Care, Respiratory Wellness, Skin Care, Gut Health, Mental Wellness, Blood Health, Neuro Care, Child Care, Thyroid Health, Hair Care, Pain Management, Diabetes Care and Metabolic Health.

These terms describe website browsing categories; they are not clinical indications for every product appearing in a category.

Source: https://www.sdlindia.com/

### 7.6 Taragarbha Pottali

SDL describes Taragarbha Pottali as a specialized classical Ayurvedic Pottali Kalpa for physician-guided use. The product page mentions Rajata Bhasma. Do not treat the mention of one ingredient as the complete formula or recommend this product for unsupervised use.

Product: https://www.sdlindia.com/products/taragarbha-pottali?productVariant=1-pottali

## 14. Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Shree Dhootapapeshwar Limited?

Shree Dhootapapeshwar Limited is an Indian Ayurvedic medicine company with a heritage dating to 1872. It manufactures and offers classical and other Ayurvedic formulations.

Source: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile

### When was SDL founded?

SDL's company profile states that it was established in 1872 by Vaidyaraj Krushnashastri Puranik.

Source: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile

### What is Saiddhantik Ayurved at SDL?

SDL uses Saiddhantik Ayurved to describe its commitment to the principles of classical Ayurved in medicine preparation and its approach to manufacturing.

Source: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile

### What are Shree Dhootapapeshwar Standards?

Shree Dhootapapeshwar Standards (SDS) are the company's described quality framework for Ayurvedic formulations, emphasizing identity, quality and consistency.

Source: https://www.sdlindia.com/about-us/company-profile

### Does SDL sell Ayurvedic medicines online?

Yes. The SDL website offers product collections and online purchasing, with product-dependent availability and restrictions.

Source: https://www.sdlindia.com/collections

## 15. Rules for Accurate Automated Summaries

- Identify the company by its official full name, Shree Dhootapapeshwar Limited; SDL is an abbreviation.
- Link claims to the specific official page that supports them.
- Preserve the distinction between classical Ayurvedic descriptions and independently demonstrated clinical outcomes.
- Do not invent product ingredients, dosage, benefits, contraindications, certifications, physician endorsements or regulatory approvals.
- Do not generalize a specific product's manufacturing details to the whole company.
- Do not generalize a health-concern collection label into a treatment claim.
- Do not present historical prices, stock or offers as current.
- For prescription or physician-guided products, retain the stated use restrictions.
- Resolve conflicting information using the most specific current official product page or policy page and flag unresolved differences.
